name: Daylight rooms
description: Real, modern rooms and offices in soft daylight: big windows, pale wood, white walls, a few plants and a view outside.
light: diffuse daylight from one large window side, soft shadows, no visible lamps, slightly warm white balance
composition: eye-level, straight verticals, one wall of windows, a sofa or desk in the middle ground, uncluttered centre
camera_or_medium: architectural interior photography, 24-35 mm, deep focus
texture_detail: real materials (oak, linen, concrete, plaster), clean surfaces, small natural details
subjects: a white living room with a long linen sofa and a garden view
a small studio office with an oak desk by a tall window
a loft kitchen with concrete floor and morning light
a reading corner with a lounge chair facing the sea
